title: Upper thoracic (T1-T2) FSU anterior and posterior shear stiffness at 1, 10 and 100 mm/s
condition: intact (rib heads retained), no axial preload

quantity.name: A-P shear stiffness
quantity.definition: tangent at the midpoint of a quadratic fit to the 3rd-cycle loading force-displacement curve (data trimmed at 180 N), separately for the low (0-50%) and high (50-100%) displacement zones; displacement of the superior vertebra along the anatomical A-P axis, inferior vertebra fixed, superior vertebra unconstrained in all other DOF; line of action through the disc centre

source.authors: Yamamoto S, Dias L, Street J, Cripton PA
source.sample: 7 T1-T2 FSUs analysed (9 tested; 2 excluded for degradation); human cadaveric upper thoracic FSUs (T1-T2) with rib heads, ligaments and disc; donors 4 F, 5 M (Caucasian)

protocol.summary: Servohydraulic displacement control via self-aligning cable (pure shear through disc centre; counterbalance for upper half mass), 5 N shear preload, 5 cycles (ramp to displacement limit giving ~200 N, 2 s hold, ramp down, 2 s hold) at 1, 10 and 100 mm/s, anterior then posterior; 6-axis load cell below inferior vertebra; Optotrak kinematics.
how_to_simulate: Model T1-T2 with disc, ligaments and rib heads (no rib cage); fix T2; no compressive preload
Apply a pure anterior (then posterior) shear force through the disc centre on T1, leaving T1 free to rotate, up to ~200 N
Fit F vs A-P displacement with a quadratic and take tangent stiffness at the midpoint of the 0-50% and 50-100% displacement ranges
Compare anterior and posterior stiffness (quasi-static models: compare with 1 mm/s or marginal means) and coupled sagittal rotation
protocol.notes: Marginal means reported with SE; sd derived as SE*sqrt(7). Rate-specific anterior low-zone means from text (no dispersion). Displacement limit 0.6-2.4 mm per specimen. Profile plots (Fig 3) and average curves (Fig 2) not digitised.

data.x: anterior shear stiffness, low-displacement zone (0-50% of total displacement)
data.load: pure A-P shear to ~200 N, marginal mean over 1/10/100 mm/s

extraction.check_notes: All values re-read from text: 230 (SE 23.3), 131 (18.3), 258 (15.1), 171 (12.4); rate means 205/210/277; flexion 0.96 (SD 0.64), extension 0.25 (SD 0.44).
